snippet.title: Shoot. Dash. Repeat. | Dashoot: ABYA’s Adventure – Early Access Nov 10
snippet.description:
Wishlist Dashoot on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670430/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=ea_date_2026&utm_content=description

Shoot the switch. Move the platform. Make the jump.
Dashoot: ABYA’s Adventure enters Steam Early Access on November 10, 2026.

Aim your floating cannon at mechanisms, collect dash items, and find your route through challenging pixel-art platforming levels. 
Play as ABYA, a robot exploring underground ruins, with AI Deus as your guide.

Watch the release date announcement trailer and add Dashoot to your Steam wishlist for launch updates.

#Dashoot #precisionplatformer  #indiegame
